1.

As per report of the office and as per communication dated 01.08.2023 furnished by the Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar, opposite party no.2 has been served, however, none is
present on her behalf.

2. Heard Shri Satendra Kumar Tiwari, holding brief of Shri Jay Prakash Singh, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Pradeep for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.0261 of 2022, under Sections 376(2) (n) I.P.C. and 4 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act, Police Station Aalapur, District Ambedkar Nagar, during trial.

4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed Pradeep vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: 5. It is further submitted that F.I.R. of the incident has been lodged by the victim herself on 21.10.2022 alleging therein that on the basis of false promise of marriage, she was being continuously raped by the applicant for the last eight years and also that an obscene video was prepared on the basis of which she was blackmailed and on many times medicine was also administered to her in order to cause abortion.

6. Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted on behalf of the applicant that as per F.I.R. and statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. first sexual activity had taken place in the year 2014 and thereafter continuously the prosecutrix stated to have been sexually assaulted, however, the F.I.R. could only be lodged after eight years i.e. in the year 2022.

7. It is further submitted that no video of any kind has been recovered during the course of investigation and the theory of obscene video has been cooked up by the informant in order to cover the delay in lodging the F.I.R.

It is also submitted that date of birth of the victim is 01.01.2000 by which she appears to be major at the date and time of the incident and therefore, invocation of the relevant provisions of the P.O.C.S.O. Act have been made without there being any basis.

It is further submitted that there is no evidence pertaining to the abortion allegedly happened with the prosecutrix/victim and even if the statements of the prosecutrix/victim are believed and taken on their face, she appears to be a consenting party and since she was major at the date and time of the incident, in fact no offence has been committed by the applicant.

It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 29.03.2023 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
8.

Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that on the basis of false promise of marriage, it is not only the applicant, who has committed rape, but also his friend has also committed sexual assault on the prosecutrix/victim and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

9. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that as per allegations levelled in the F.I.R., which is lodged by none other than the victim herself and in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. first sexual activity is shown to have occurred in the year 2014 and thereafter on the basis of obscene video filmed at the time of commission of rape, the prosecutrix was continuously blackmailed.
It is stated in the F.I.R. by the victim herself that medicine for causing abortion was administered to her with her consent.
The prosecutrix was aged about 22 years at the date and time of the incident.
There is no medical evidence pertaining to causing of abortion by the applicant, however, the disputed questions of fact may only be determined/adjudicated in the trial.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 29.03.2023 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

sentences.text: Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case
, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

11. Let the accused/applicant- Pradeep involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
13. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
14. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.
